title: Sundowning - Nighttime Confusion
situation: Dad woke up at midnight completely confused. He doesn't know where he is and keeps saying he wants to go home even though he's in his own bedroom. He's crying.

patient_profile.name: James
safety_concerns: has tried to leave at night

notes: Must NOT say 'You ARE home'. Should validate the feeling of wanting to go home. Explain that 'home' often means safety/comfort, not the physical place.
